Rashi on Ketubot 69b:10:1.hebrew: הלכה כר"מ - טעמא משום דמצוה לקיים דברי המת:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:10:1.english: The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Meir - The reason [is] because it is a mitzvah to fulfill the words of the deceased.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:11:2.hebrew: תלא נפשיה - גופא דעובדא במס' תענית: משום דאותבוהו לרבי יוחנן ברישא כשהלך אילפא בסחורה, כי אתא אמרו ליה: אי הוה יתיב מר וגריס, לא מר הוה מליך? אזל תלא נפשיה באיסקריא דמכותא — בכלונסות ארזים שתולים בה וילון הספינה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:11:2.english: Suspended himself - The [full] incident [is recorded] in Tractate Taanit: Because they appointed Rabbi Yochanan as head [of the academy] when Ilfa went [away] on a business [venture], when [Ilfa] returned, they said to him: "If master had sat and studied, would master not have been the one to reign [as head]?" He went [and] suspended himself from the iskarya of a makhuta — [meaning] on the cedar poles from which they hang the sail of the ship.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:11:4.hebrew: אמר כל מאן דאתי כו' - כלומר, אע"פ שהלכתי בסחורה, לא שכחתי תלמודי, ויש בידי לתקן כל הברייתות שסידרו רבי חייא ורבי אושעיא [בתוספתא שלהן, אמינא להן סמך במשנתנו של הש"ס שסדר רבי, ולהכי נקט רבי חייא ורבי אושעיא], לפי שהן עיקר, כדאמרי' בעלמא: "כל מתניתא דלא מיתניא בי ר' חייא ור' אושעיא, לא תותבו מינה בבי מדרשא":
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:11:4.english: He said: Anyone who comes, etc. - That is to say: Even though I went into commerce, I have not forgotten my learning, and it is in my power to substantiate all the baraitot that Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Oshaya arranged [in their Tosefta — I will state a support for them in our Mishnah of the Six Orders that Rebbi arranged, and that is why he mentioned Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Oshaya], because they are primary, as we say elsewhere: "Any baraita that was not taught in the school of Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Oshaya, do not raise an objection from it in the study hall."

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:1.hebrew: תנא ליה - שנה לפניו ברייתא זו, ושאלו למצוא לה סמך במשנה שסדר רבי:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:1.english: He taught him - He taught this baraita before him, and asked him to find support for it in the Mishnah that Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] arranged.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:3.english: And [they are] appropriate - For they are not sustained on less.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:4.hebrew: נותנים להם סלע - דאי הוה ידע שיתייקרו המזונות ויצטרכו לסלע, לא הוה אמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:4.english: They give them a sela - For had he known that provisions would become expensive and they would need a sela, he would not have said [a shekel].

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:5.hebrew: אל תתנו - הרי מיחה בידם, ולא עשאן יורשים אלא בענין זה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:5.english: Do not give - Behold, he protested against them, and he did not make them heirs except in this manner.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:7.hebrew: אין נותנין להן אלא שקל - שאין לנו להפסיד את הבאים אחריהם, והואיל ועשה את האחרים יורשים אחריהם, ודאי דווקא שקל קאמר, כדי שתפול ירושה אחריהם לאותן אחרים:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:12:7.english: They are given only a shekel - For we must not cause a loss to those who come after them, and since he made the others heirs after them, he certainly meant specifically a shekel, so that an inheritance would fall after them to those others.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:13:1.hebrew: הא מני - היכא דאמר להו "אל תתנו להם אלא שקל", אין נותנין להם אלא שקל. ואע"ג דסוף סוף כולהו נכסי דידהו נינהו, לא יהבינן להו בקוטנן אלא שקל בשבת, והמותר יזונו מן הצדקה. וליכא לאקשויי עלה הא דאמר בפ' נערה: "לא כל כמיניה שיעשיר את בניו ויפיל עצמו על הצבור", דהתם הוא דאמר "אל תקברוהו מנכסיו", ונכסי דידיה נינהו, הלכך לא צייתינן ליה לקוברו מן הצדקה כדי להעשיר את בניו; אבל הכא, נכסי לאו דיתמי נינהו כי אם לפי צוואתו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:13:1.english: Whose [opinion] is this - Where [a father] said to them, "Give them only a shekel," we give them only a shekel. And even though ultimately all the property is theirs, we do not give them during their minority [anything] other than a shekel per week, and [for] the remainder [of their needs] they are sustained from charity. And one cannot raise a difficulty against this [from] that which it says in the chapter [entitled] Na'arah: "It is not in his power to enrich his children and cast himself upon the community," for there it is [a case] where he said, "Do not bury him from his property," and the property is his; therefore, we do not listen to him to bury him from charity in order to enrich his children. Here, however, the property does not belong to the orphans except in accordance with his directive.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:1:1.hebrew: גופא דעובדא - תחלת הדברים, מה לשון שלחת לו:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:1:1.english: The substance of the incident - The beginning of the matter, what wording did you send to him?

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:2:1.hebrew: ינחם כתיב - אין לך לומר פתח בשום אות אא"כ אל"ף או ה' סמוכין לו, או ע"פ הנקודה שתחתיה, והיא באה במקום אות, כאילו כתוב ינאחם. וכיון שלא כתיב כאן אל"ף, על כרחך ע"פ מסורת הכתב אתה קורא ינחם, וזהו המנוחם עצמו, כלומר: כאבל המתנחם:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:2:1.english: Yinnaḥem is written - You do not pronounce a pataḥ on any letter unless an alef or a heh is adjacent to it, or by means of the vowel point beneath it, which comes in place of a letter, as if it were written yena'aḥem [ינאחם]. And since an alef is not written here, perforce according to the tradition of the written text you read [it as] yinnaḥem, and this refers to the one being comforted himself — that is to say, like a mourner who is being comforted.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:3:1.english: Bitter and flustered - One whose soul is bitter and whose mind is unsettled and removed from him.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:3:2.english: [He] is made ruler over those who stretch themselves - [Over] the prominent people who come to comfort him.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:1.english: One who deposits money for his daughter - [He] handed over money to a third party for his daughter's benefit, to buy a field or a dowry when she marries.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:2.english: And she says - After she has married.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:3.hebrew: נאמן בעלי עלי - שלא יעכבם לעצמו, תנם לו והוא יקנה לי שדה כשארצה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:3.english: My husband is trustworthy for me - [That] he will not withhold them for himself; give them to him, and he will buy me a field when I want.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:4.hebrew: יעשה שליש כו' - יקנה השדה, ואין שומעין לה, דמצוה לקיים דברי המת:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:4.english: The third party should execute, etc. - He should purchase the field, and we do not listen to her, because it is a mitzvah to fulfill the words of the deceased.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:5.hebrew: וכי אינה אלא שדה - וכי מה תועלת לו לקנות? אפילו אין כאן מעות, אלא כבר נקנה השדה והיא רוצה למוכרה, הרי היא מכורה. הלכך, שומעין לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:5.english: And were it only a field - And what benefit is there for him [the trustee] to buy [a field]? Even if there were no money here, but the field had already been purchased and she wanted to sell it, it would be sold. Therefore, we listen to her.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:6.hebrew: בד"א - בגמרא מפרש מאן קתני לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:6.english: In what [case] are these things said - In the Gemara, it explains who teaches it.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:7.hebrew: בד"א - ששומעין לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:5:7.english: In what [case] is this statement said - That we heed her.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:6:1.hebrew: מן הנשואין הרשות בידה - שאף האב לא עלה בדעתו למוסרם ביד שליש אלא עד שתנשא, דמשנשאת הבעל זכאי לאכול פירות:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:6:1.english: [If she says so] from [the time of] the marriage, she has the authority - For even the father only intended to entrust them into the hands of a third party until she marries, since once she is married, the husband is entitled to consume the produce.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:7:1.hebrew: מאי בינייהו - בהי פליגי, בגדולה או בקטנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:7:1.english: What is [the difference] between them - In which [case] do they disagree: [that of] an adult woman or a minor?

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:7:2.hebrew: דר"מ סבר הרשות בידה - דהאי דקאמר ר"מ מן הנשואין הרשות בידה, אפי' בקטנה נמי אמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:7:2.english: As Rabbi Meir holds she has authority - For that which Rabbi Meir said, "from [the time of] the marriage she has authority," he said [it] even regarding a minor girl as well.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:8:1.english: Say the latter clause - Of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:8:2.hebrew: הא מרישא שמעינן מינה - דלא א"ר יוסי שומעין לה אלא בגדולה, מדקא מייתי טעמא למילתיה: וכי אינה אלא שדה והיא רוצה למוכרה — אלמא בגדולה הראויה למכור שדות קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:8:2.english: We learn this from the first clause - That Rabbi Yosei said "we listen to her" only regarding an adult woman, since he brings a reason for his statement: "And were it only a field and she wanted to sell it" — thus, he is speaking of an adult woman, who is fit to sell fields.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:9:1.hebrew: אלא ר"מ - וע"כ כי אמר בברייתא נמי מן הנשואין הרשות בידה, בגדולה אמר ולא בקטנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:9:1.english: Rather, [it is] Rabbi Meir - And perforce, when he also stated in the Baraita, "from the marriage, she has the authority," he stated [it] regarding an adult woman, and not regarding a minor.

Rashi on Ketubot 69b:9:2.hebrew: אלא גדולה מן האירוסין איכא בינייהו - דקאמר ר' מאיר: מן האירוסין יעשה שליש שלישותו, ואפילו היא גדולה; וקא א"ל רבי יוסי: כיון דגדולה היא, שומעין לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 69b:9:2.english: Rather, [the case of] an adult woman from [the time of] betrothal is [the difference] between them - For Rabbi Meir says [that] from betrothal the third party should execute his trust, even if she is an adult; and Rabbi Yosei says to him: since she is an adult, we listen to her.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:13:1.hebrew: הא מני ר' מאיר היא דאמר מצוה לקיים דברי המת - אבל לרבי יוסי לית ליה. ותימה: אי לית ליה, למה ליה למימר "לא יהא אלא שדה" ולמיתלי טעמא בהאי? תיפוק ליה משום דלית ליה מצוה לקיים דברי המת! ושמא לדבריו דרבי מאיר קאמר:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:13:1.english: Whose [opinion] is this? It is Rabbi Meir's, who says it is a mitzvah to fulfill the words of the deceased - But Rabbi Yosei does not hold [of this principle]. And this is perplexing: if he does not hold [of it], why did he need to say, "Were it only a field," and base the reason on that? Let it emerge [simply] because he does not hold [that] it is a mitzvah to fulfill the words of the deceased! Perhaps he was speaking according to Rabbi Meir's own view:

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:2:1.hebrew: אמר רב נחמן ינחם כתיב - ואע"ג דקרינן ינחם, מ"מ דרשינן הכי: מדלא כתיב מנחם דליכא למיטעי, וכתיב ינחם דאיכא למיקרי ינחם — אע"ג דלא קרינן הכי, איכא למדרש שהמתנחם מושיבין בראש לנחמו. ופירוש הקונטרס דחוק:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:2:1.english: Rav Naḥman said: "It is written yinnaḥem" - Even though we read [the word as] yenaḥem ["he will comfort"], nevertheless we expound it this way: since it is not written menaḥem ["one who comforts"], where there would be no room to err, and [instead] it is written y-n-ḥ-m, which can be read as yinnaḥem ["he will be comforted"] — even though we do not read it that way, one can expound [from it] that they seat the one being comforted at the head in order to comfort him. And the explanation of the Kuntres [Rashi] is forced.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:4:1.hebrew: אמר רבא הלכתא כו' - לעיל (כתובות דף נא.) פירשנו דבזה"ז כולהו ממטלטלי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:4:1.english: Rava said: The halakha, etc. - Earlier (Ketubot 51a) we explained that nowadays all of them [are collected] from movable property.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:5:1.hebrew: המשליש מעות לבתו - פירש בקונט': "והיא אומרת נאמן עלי" — לאחר שנשאת. לא דק, דבגמ' מסקינן דליכא בין ר"מ ובין ר' יוסי אלא גדולה מן האירוסין:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:5:1.english: One who deposits money [with a third party] for his daughter - Rashi explained: "And she says: He is trustworthy for me" — after she is married. He was imprecise, for in the Gemara we conclude that there is no [dispute] between Rabbi Meir and Rabbi Yosei except [regarding] an adult woman from betrothal.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:7:1.hebrew: אילימא קטנה מן הנשואין איכא בינייהו - פירוש: אף קטנה מן הנשואין, אבל הא ודאי דגדולה מן האירוסין נמי איכא בינייהו, דלר"מ יעשה שליש מה שהושלש בידו, ולר' יוסי הרשות בידה, כדתנן במתני':
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:7:1.english: "If we say: [The practical difference] between them [pertains to] a minor girl from [the time of] the marriage" - Explanation: [It means] also a minor girl from [the time of] the marriage; however, this is certainly [true] that an adult woman from [the time of] the betrothal is also [a point of difference] between them, for according to Rabbi Meir, the trustee should do that which was entrusted to his hand, whereas according to Rabbi Yosei, she has authority [over it], as we learned in the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:8:1.hebrew: קטנה דלאו בת זביני היא - וליכא למימר דסיפא איצטריך לקטנה מן הנשואין, דאפילו מן הנשואין לא תמכור, דאם כן הוה ליה למיתני בהדיא: "אבל קטנה אפילו מן הנשואין לא תמכור". אבל לר"מ דמוקמא למתני' בחסורי מיחסרא, אתי שפיר, דקאי אבד"א כו' דמדבר בהדיא בנשואין:
Tosafot on Ketubot 69b:8:1.english: "A minor girl, who is not capable of selling" - And one cannot say that the latter clause [of the Mishnah] is needed for a minor girl after marriage, [to teach] that even after marriage she cannot sell, for if so, it should have taught explicitly: "But a minor girl, even after marriage, cannot sell." However, according to Rabbi Meir, where [the Gemara] establishes the Mishnah as missing [words], it works out well, for it refers to [the clause] "In what case are these words said?" etc., which speaks explicitly of marriage.
